Name: Dam - Bahasa Indonesia
Author: Emerald986
Description:
A translation of dam mod
Just drop it on i18n files, and voila. U fine to go!.

I suggest to use [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/games/stardewvalley/mods?sort=updatedAt]Indonesia language mod by Wisnu Nug[/url] so it will automaticly change the language. And no need replacing the default.json of i18n

Also credit to [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/games/stardewvalley/mods?sort=updatedAt]tikamin557[/url] who made this great expansion mod! I'm very appreciate this!

Downloads.Description: Just copy and drop the i18n files to the folder, and you ready to go!
